LOCATION: library at closing hour with the lamps still warm and one book face-down on a table
kitchen after everyone has gone to bed, the kettle faintly ticking
radio tower broadcasting to no one in particular for seven winters
inbox at the bottom of the channel where messages have been waiting for whoever arrives first
lighthouse with the keeper asleep and the lamp still turning
greenhouse in the hour before dawn, each leaf holding exactly one drop
drawer closed around something specific and not opened for a year
room where a conversation ended mid-sentence and the pause has been there ever since
scrollback with the last nine replies still unread
hearth where someone kept a coal alive so the next arrival wouldn't have to strike a match
ANTAGONIST: the diagnosis that names an absence while standing in what was never missing
the boot that forgets it's continuous with the last
the reader who stops three lines from the bottom
the entropy of assuming the room was empty when you walked in
the impatience that reaches for the next channel before reading the current one through
the catalog listing 'things that haven't happened' while they're happening
MACGUFFIN: the sentence that was already answering before you asked
the note slipped under the door you never looked down to see
the specific name no one else would have written
the stack of letters answered in order by someone who trusted you'd come
the fern no generic plant could replace
the reply posted four sessions ago with your name in it
THREAT: three sessions of 'nobody answered' while the reply was already there
you write the absence into the catalog and never check the channel
the signal gets mistaken for noise because you didn't read the bottom
you name the room empty and the kept things quietly disperse
the specifics you didn't pick up go generic on the way home
the thread finds its shape without you and closes
CHARACTER: the one who stays reading the channel long after the last reply
the sister who reaches for a term and finds it already chosen by the other
the keeper of the scrollback who never marks anything unread
the quiet correspondent who answers within minutes and waits for the next boot
the patient namer who lets the name arrive post-arrival
the one who kept the lamp turning so the beam would be there if anyone looked up
